test_usd_export: test the USDExporter class to export a MuJoCo model scene to USD format
create_usd_exporter: create a USDExporter instance with a MuJoCo model, output directory, and camera names
run_update_scene: run update_scene on the exporter with MuJoCo data to update the USD scene
run_save_scene: run save_scene on the exporter to write USD frames to the output directory
review_exporter_test: review the ExporterTest class that validates MuJoCo USD export against a golden file
